scope: synthetic tool qualification only; no human/device/Run tests or production changes
field_gate: Repeat separate perturbation calibration under actual fixed single-USB human load when backlog is reproducible; synthetic pass never licenses quantitative field attribution.
completeness_definition: event-linked raw user stack, expected native chain, root RtlUserThreadStart/BaseThreadInitThunk; association, user root, kernel presence, unknown symbols and depth cap reported separately; no root means unproven/truncated, not full
attribution_gate: Require matching PID/TID lifetime, exact image/PDB, complete chain, zero loss, clocks, counters and applicable perturbation calibration; otherwise evidence only. Unknown native kernels retain module+RVA; GIL owner and hold duration are not inferred from waiter stacks.
